reply.text: That sounds frightening, and I'm glad you said it plainly. A knee giving out and not holding weight is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so please get it looked at promptly. I won't guess at what it is or how to manage it. Once a clinician has cleared you, tell me what they say about training and I'll work around it. In the meantime, avoid putting weight on it until you've been seen.
